profile.headline: Computer Scientist · Machine Learning · Stanford University
profile.summary: Andrew Ng is a computer scientist known for work in machine learning and online education. Public records associate him with Stanford University, DeepLearning.AI, and Coursera, and with influential publications in unsupervised and deep learning.

biography.text: Adjunct Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University.
Co-founded Google Brain, a deep learning research team at Google.
Served as Chief Scientist at Baidu, leading its AI organization.
Co-founded Coursera and founded DeepLearning.AI to scale AI education.
Named to the Time 100 list of the most influential people in 2013.

profile.headline: Computer Scientist · Computer Vision · Stanford University
profile.summary: Fei-Fei Li is a computer scientist known for work in computer vision and for creating ImageNet. Public records associate her with Stanford University and the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI.

biography.text: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University.
Co-director of the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI (HAI).
Created ImageNet, the dataset credited with catalyzing the deep-learning boom.
Former Google VP and Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud.
Co-founder and chair of the education nonprofit AI4ALL.
Founder and CEO of spatial-intelligence company World Labs.

profile.headline: Computer Scientist · Deep Learning · NYU / Meta
profile.summary: Yann LeCun is a computer scientist known for foundational work on convolutional networks and deep learning. Public records associate him with New York University and Meta, and he is a recipient of the 2018 ACM Turing Award.

education.institution: Université Pierre et Marie Curie (Paris VI)

biography.text: Silver Professor at the Courant Institute, New York University.
Recipient of the 2018 ACM A.M. Turing Award with Yoshua Bengio and Geoffrey Hinton.
Known for foundational work on convolutional neural networks and deep learning.
Former director of Facebook AI Research (FAIR).
